title: Maekon managed.json (MDM policy overlay)
description: Enterprise MDM policy overlay for the Maekon desktop client (E20-40 #4832; schema published in E20-45 #4837). Deploy this file read-only to the system-wide, admin-writable managed-config location; any field present LOCKS the corresponding AppConfig path (the local user cannot override it). The struct in crates/maekon-core/src/config/managed.rs IS the lockable allowlist — only the fields below can be locked. Unknown extra keys are tolerated (forward-compat: a file authored for a newer schema_version must not brick an older client), which is why every object permits additionalProperties; a schema_version newer than the client supports is rejected fail-closed at load. A present-but-malformed file (bad type / bad enum token) is also fail-closed (the app refuses to start unmanaged). This schema mirrors that runtime contract: known fields are strictly typed and enum-constrained; unknown keys pass.

schema_version.description: managed.json schema version. The current client supports version 1 (ManagedConfig::SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION). A file authored for a newer version is rejected fail-closed.

pii_filter_level.description: Locks privacy.pii_filter_level. Higher levels mask more PII on-device before any upload.

enabled.description: Locks telemetry.enabled. Locking false hard-disables OTLP telemetry egress fleet-wide.

capture_enabled.description: Locks vision.capture_enabled. Locking false hard-disables screen capture fleet-wide.

cloud_stt_policy.description: Locks audio.cloud_stt_policy — the fleet gate for cloud speech-to-text raw-audio egress, independent of whether any individual user enters an API key. 'disabled' means raw audio never leaves the device.

enabled.description: Locks update.enabled. Locking false is an immediate fleet update kill-switch: the update loop never spawns and the coordinator stays Idle.

min_allowed_version.description: Locks update.min_allowed_version (semver). Pins the oldest release the auto-updater may install — a downgrade/rollback guard below a security baseline. A release below this floor is rejected (#4836).

max_allowed_version.description: Locks update.max_allowed_version (semver). Freezes the fleet at/below a known-good version — a soft update kill-switch that, unlike enabled=false, still permits updates up to the cap. A release above this ceiling is held (reported up-to-date), not installed (#4836). Must be >= min_allowed_version when both are set.
